GEOGCRS["WGS 84",
    ENSEMBLE["World Geodetic System 1984 ensemble",
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (Transit)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G730)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G873)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G1150)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G1674)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G1762)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G2139)"],
        MEMBER["World Geodetic System 1984 (G2296)"],
        ELLIPSOID["WGS 84",6378137,298.257223563,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
        ENSEMBLEACCURACY[2.0]],
    PRIMEM["Greenwich",0,
        ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
    CS[ellipsoidal,2],
        AXIS["geodetic latitude (Lat)",north,
            ORDER[1],
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
        AXIS["geodetic longitude (Lon)",east,
            ORDER[2],
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
    USAGE[
        SCOPE["Horizontal component of 3D system."],
        AREA["World."],
        BBOX[-90,-180,90,180]],
    ID["EPSG",4326]]

description.topo: raster of the topography and/or bathymetry usually expressed in meter below/above sea level
description.labs: vector layer used for labeling reconstructed biogeographical shapes
description.curve: vector or (list of) raster(s) expressing the relative shift in altitude over time for the biogeographical system of interest (e.g. relative sea level, upper forest limit)
description.correction: vector or (list of) raster(s) expressing vertical motion due to geotectonic and geophysical activities (e.g. uplift/subsidence, delta aggregation, volcanism)

period.description: character; lower bound of a time period expressed in years before/after present for a reconstruction at a specific curve value (e.g. sea level position)

curve.description: numeric; curve value (e.g. sea level position) for that period; In case of a raster (e.g., st_curve; spatial-explicit curve) the average curve value is calculated within the region

correction.description: numeric; correction value (e.g. uplift/subsidence) for that period; In case of a raster the average correction value is calculated within the region

iso.description: numeric; meter above or below the curve value (e.g. sea level position) defining the lower bound of the biogeographic region

unique_id.description: integer; unique identifier of a biogeographic unit or region for a time period

area.description: numeric; size of a biogeographic unit/region in square meter

n.description: integer; number of cells at the resolution of the topo within a biogeographic unit/region; Will change if the res_level parameter is modified

x.description: numeric; x-coordinate in degrees (SRID=4326) of the highest point within a biogeographic unit/region extracted through intersection with topo; in case the highest point could not be extracted the centroid of a biogeographic unit/region is used

y.description: numeric; y-coordinate in degrees (SRID=4326) of the highest point within a biogeographic unit/region extracted through intersection with topo; in case the highest point could not be extracted the centroid of a biogeographic unit/region is used

z.description: numeric; meter above/below present sea level of the highest point within a biogeographic unit/region extracted through intersection with topo; in case the highest point could not be extracted the centroid of a biogeographic unit/region is used

recid.description: character; reconstructed id, when biogeographic units merge over time it is named after the biogeographic region with the highest point. The id is included cause it is unique across islands with identical names

recname.description: character; reconstructed name, when biogeographic units merge over time it is named after the biogeographic region with the highest point

definitions.UNKNOWN: the name of the island is unknown

recnames.description: json object including the name and id of intersecting reconstructed polygons (from t0 until ti, where t=time period) within a reconstructed polygon of ti

refnames.description: json object including the name and id of intersecting labeling points/polygons (from t0 until ti, where t=time period) within a reconstructed polygon of ti

unique_id.description: integer; unique identifier of a shape in the labeling dataset

name.description: character; name of a shape in the labeling dataset

refx.description: numeric; x-coordinate (SRID=4326) of the highest point of a biogeographic unit in the labeling dataset; in case the labeling dataset are points the x-coordinate of the point is given

refy.description: numeric; y-coordinate (SRID=4326) of the highest point of a biogeographic unit in the labeling dataset; in case the labeling dataset are points the y-coordinate of the point is given

refz.description: integer; elevation of the highest point of a biogeographic unit in the labeling dataset; in case the labeling dataset are points the z-coordinate of the point is given

refn.description: integer; number of cells at the resolution of the topo within a biogeographic unit in the labeling dataset; in case the labeling dataset are points the number of cells will equal to 1
